admin:tutor-requests/ADMIN/dark-1440.tour_last: Variability tour — attack the seat-limit field, then race the limit it sets
admin:tutor-requests/ADMIN/dark-1440.notes: Depth 3 via the real UI: a fresh learner requested tutor status, the operator approved it with a seat limit of 3, and the decision survived a real reload (the PENDING queue reads 'No pending requests'). Downstream contract verified against the API: tenant created with seatLimit 3 + joinCode, owner membership OWNER/active, user role TENANT_OWNER, TENANT_STARTER subscription ACTIVE (source ADMIN), and an audit row 'tutor_request.approve' with the correct admin attribution. Seat-limit input attacks all rejected server-side with clear zod errors: -5 and 0 -> 'greater than or equal to 1', 1.5 -> 'Expected integer, received float', 999999999999 -> 'less than or equal to 100000'. XSS in the org name () round-trips as literal text in the admin panel (0 injected imgs) and the tenant slug is sanitised to 'img-src-x-onerror-alert-1'. The one thing that does NOT hold is the limit itself: see GHSA-2r57-gmq8-w83r, re-confirmed on this brand-new org (1 active, limit 3, four concurrent POST /tenant/students all 201 -> 5 active; a sequential create one moment later returns 402 'used 5 - limit 3'). Two small observations: the admin surfaces server validation as a native alert('Validation error') that drops the per-field detail the API actually returns (O118), and the seat-limit input is min=0 while the server requires >= 1 (O119). The seat limit the operator typed is not recorded in the audit metadata -- the same lossy-audit shape as F114/#61.

admin:users.id/ADMIN/dark-1440.notes: F91/#43 SOLVED and FIXED. It was never flaky: GET /admin/users/:id 500s the FIRST time it is ever called for a user with no personal Subscription row, and 200s forever after -- which is why 37+ retries across three cycles were always clean. Cause: admin/users.controller.ts:182-185 awaits getSubscriptionForUser(id) and getUsageVsLimits(id) in the same Promise.all, and getUsageVsLimits calls getSubscriptionForUser again (subscription/user.ts:203); that function was findUnique-then-create on a unique userId, so one request raced ITSELF and the loser threw P2002 -> unhandled -> 500. Tenant students are the population with no row, which is why every sighting was a freshly created student. Reproduced 3/3 deterministically via owner-creates-student -> first admin GET = 500, second = 200; confirmed in the real browser (console 500 on first load, masked afterwards by react-query's retry). Fixed by making the create idempotent (catch P2002 -> re-read). Verified: fresh student now 200 on first GET (API) and zero console errors on first browser load. getSubscriptionForTenant does not auto-create, so the tenant path never had this race. | Depth 3 on impersonation, the largest untouched section-G flow. Drove the real chain: admin panel mints via POST /admin/users/:id/impersonate -> the browser opens /uz/impersonate?token=<JWT> from a cleared context -> the target session is stored (talim-auth = qa-owner@talim.local / TENANT_OWNER) -> a real mutation as the impersonated tutor (PATCH /tenant, 200) -> a real location.reload(), after which the session survives and the tutor dashboard still renders as QA Owner. Abuse matrix mostly CLEAN and re-confirmed: /admin/* from an imp session 403 (incl. chaining another impersonation), tampered signature 401, payload rewritten to role=ADMIN with the original signature 401, self 400, unknown id 404, TTL exactly 30 min. Three things do NOT hold, all folded into GHSA-v8gx-9qfw-92f4 (raised low -> medium this cycle rather than duplicated): (1) TRANSPORT -- the credential is a URL query parameter (admin users/[id]/page.tsx:170-176) and nginx.conf sets no access_log, so nginx default combined logs $request with the query string; a 30-minute unrevocable bearer token for another account is written to a production log on every use (CWE-598). (2) The impersonate page comment claiming one-shot consumption is false -- replay measured 200 on 5/5 and 3/3 across two independent mints; comment corrected in source this cycle. (3) Zero-audit confirmed empirically rather than by code reading: PATCH /tenant inside the imp session returned 200 and /admin/audit-logs held 50 rows before and 50 after. Re-confirmed the original advisory findings too: 0 banners, no impersonation marker anywhere in the rendered text, and the only exit-shaped control is the ordinary Chiqish (log out).
